nom: THAYERS Original Witch Hazel Astringent with Aloe Vera

segments.oily: A reviewer with oily skin reports the toner suits her skin type well, cuts oil, and causes no irritation.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer who describes herself as sensitive to alcohol-based aftershave reports this product, despite containing about 10% alcohol, leaves her skin smooth and hydrated post-shave.
segments.normal: One reviewer who says she is always testing new products and had never had this happen before reports her whole face became burnt, red, itchy and burning, with a dermatologist telling her the redness would take at least three days to resolve.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some expecting witch hazel to be drying, report the aloe vera content keeps skin feeling clean and hydrated rather than tight or dried out; no reviewer reports the product as drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a severe reaction with facial burning, redness and itching that a dermatologist said would take several days to resolve; the large majority of reviewers, including some specifically sensitive to alcohol-based products, report no stinging, burning or irritation at all.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer using the product every other day for two weeks reports her acne clearing up and improved evenness, including help with premenstrual breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the toner cuts oil while rinsing clean without feeling stripped.

aspects.libelle: Priced higher than comparable witch hazel brands
Textured pads double as gentle exfoliation
Bottle occasionally leaks in shipping or multi-packs

extraits.texte: BUYERS BEWARE!!!! I purchased this product and now my whole face has been burnt! This has never happened to my skin and i am always testing new products. My face turned so red i could not go to work in addition to that I am constantly burning and itching on my face... Unfortunately my dermatologist told me the redness and discomfort will not go away for at least 3 days if not more. Do not trust this product.

extraits.titre: I definitely love it but super overpriced.
extraits.texte: Do I love it? Hell yes! Is it overpriced? Hell yeah. So let me explain you can get a bottle double to triple the size from Humphreys or Dickson for either the same price or less. The reason why I love this one is because the aloe Vera makes your face softer and less dry. However if Humphreys or Dickson has one with aloe Vera that find im definitely getting that over this. I will try each one and see which I like more. You might ask well should I buy it? My answer is if you like to give it a try sure if your just looking for witch Hazel as a toner, than there's better value for the same thing. I have seen a big bottle of Humphreys or Dickson witch Hazel in Marshall's from 4 to 6 dollars.

This is the best astringent on the market. I have tried several astringents from some of the top beauty lines, where the astringent is much more expensive and you'd obviously expect it to work better. But it did not. I not only have Thayers astringent I also use various other products that they have and I am thoroughly impressed. I like this astringent, because it doesn't have a alcohol base, like other astringents, I find have a burning tingling feeling that I do not like on my skin, and I'm sure it's probably not good for the skin because of that. But this is so smooth. It's so versatile, it's easy to apply and the bottle lasts at least two months. This is astringent I highly recommend.

I recently purchased this toner from Amazon, and I'm quite pleased with it. It comes in well-designed packaging, and the scent is pleasant. Given my oily skin, I find it suitable for my skin type, as well as for those with oily or combination skin. In fact, I believe it could work well for all skin types. I've experienced no irritation or adverse reactions after using it. The scent is appealing, and the fact that it's colorless is a bonus. I typically use it after washing my face and removing makeup. What's particularly satisfying is that even after washing my face, I can still see residual dirt on the cotton pad when I use this toner. It effectively cleanses my skin, and I can visibly see the difference it makes. Overall, I'm quite fond of this toner and find it effective in keeping my skin clean and refreshed.

Great for a quick cleansing. Feels clean but not drying. Cuts the oil and rinses clean but not squeaky clean. The ‘rough’ side is great for a quick exfoliation. It’s probably the best witch hazel pad with natural ingredients. Smell is neutral, no strong alcohol smell. Container seals well so the pads don’t dry out. Am on my number 20 jar? Haha.
